description.fun: Comfey is a tiny fairy that makes itself a lei: it picks flowers with sticky vines from its head, threads them into a ring around itself, and gives the rings to people it likes. It rubs oil from its body onto the flowers so they give off a soothing scent and never wither, and hospitals and Pokémon Centers use that aroma to help patients. Without its flowers, it feels uneasy.
description.guide: Comfey is a Fairy-type Pokémon from Alola based on the Hawaiian lei. It gathers flowers into a ring and coats them with a soothing oil used in hospitals and Pokémon Centers. It is one of the smallest Pokémon and doesn't evolve.
description.tagline: A tiny fairy that wears a healing flower lei
